# Construct Petersen graph
petersen = set()
# outer pentagon
for i in range(5):
    petersen.add((i, (i+1)%5))
# inner star (5-cycle: 5-7-9-6-8-5)
inner = [5,7,9,6,8]
for i in range(5):
    petersen.add((inner[i], inner[(i+1)%5]))
# connections
for i in range(5):
    petersen.add((i, i+5))

# Normalize edges (u<v)
petersen_norm = set()
for u,v in petersen:
    if u>v: u,v=v,u
    petersen_norm.add((u,v))

print("Petersen edges:", sorted(petersen_norm))
print("Number of edges:", len(petersen_norm))

# Compute complement
complement = []
for i in range(10):
    for j in range(i+1, 10):
        if (i,j) not in petersen_norm:
            complement.append((i,j))

print("Complement edges:", complement)
print("Number of complement edges:", len(complement))

# Check degrees
deg = [0]*10
for u,v in complement:
    deg[u]+=1
    deg[v]+=1
print("Degrees:", deg)
print("Min degree:", min(deg))
